chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, who said:

You should say: 'O Allah, humiliate Your servant among Your servants and Your city. O Allah, make Your fire reach him and make him taste the severity of Your punishment, for he used to be inimical to Your friends and befriend Your enemies, and used to hate the People of the Household of Your Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).'

key_terms.أَهْلَ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّكَ: The People of the Household of Your Prophet

ai.seo_question: What is the specific dua for cursing or humiliating an enemy of the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this supplication (du'a) is recited during the prostration (sujood) of the daily prayers to affirm the enmity of the Nasibi against the Ahl al-Bayt, a practice rooted in the concept of *al-wala' wa al-barra'* (loyalty and disavowal). The text explicitly links the individual's spiritual corruption to their specific opposition to the Prophet's family, serving as a ritual declaration of theological allegiance. This act transforms personal enmity into a structured component of worship, reinforcing the believer's identity within the Shia tradition.
